purpose: Two-L4 distributed-data-parallel execution path for the governed U1 Sonar runner

implementation.launcher: torchrun with two local CUDA ranks
implementation.sample_sharding: deterministic disjoint rank-specific global microstep offsets
implementation.gradient_sync: DDP synchronization on the final accumulation microstep only
implementation.validation: rank zero on the complete held-out validation support with rank barriers
implementation.run_directory: rank-zero creation with broadcast identity and shared local filesystem

cloud_quota.detail: Quota Increase Requests per day exhausted for cloudquotas.googleapis.com.
cloud_quota.next_retry: Retry the quota preference update after the provider daily request allowance resets.

limitations: IMPLEMENTED does not mean VALIDATED-RUN; the two-L4 NCCL benchmark has not executed.
Exact two-times speedup is not claimed. The benchmark acceptance target is at least 1.8 times branch throughput relative to the matching one-L4 effective-batch benchmark.
This implementation covers the formal U1 Sonar runner. RGB, Range, Geometry, M1, T1, and J1 still require their own formal runners and qualifying data before complete-P4 scaling can be claimed.
